text: Studio signed off the CR6d slot sketch on 2026-09-27, with the lead's three positions. Core owns only method-determined words (not sequential replay; mean is B and D = M - B; the contrast needed all its pairs; the weighting sentence). The confound sentence is a Studio host clause (DESIGN_SPEC §12 verbatim). Causes are typed with English display labels matching the board: overlap, no-fixations, duplicate-ordinals, rejected-records, 'absent (no fixation records)'. Additions: (a) BelowMinimumQueries: Breakdown(participant x group level -> count) from the report cells, whether or not the minimum was applied; (b) ControlsPerQuery carries Range plus (count, typed cause) for queries below the maximum; (c) confirm frame/screen, declared px/deg and conversion, degrees origin and orientation, the outside-window policy words, and grid, cell and sigma list all come from CR6b plan clauses, otherwise give each a slot; (d) the reporting spec's name comes from ReportSpec (state it) or is a host Label. Structural: every filled Token.Fact carries a typed FactSource (ledger inventory path / Report cell or contrast key / plan field / host fact) so Studio can link each number to a StudioRef.
